name: CSL Observatory org-metrics snapshot
description: Org-level GitHub/CDSL maintenance metrics (repositories, issues, PRs, commits, contributors, taxonomy and reach) for the sanskrit-lexicon organisation. Offline, reproducible from the committed CSVs.

distribution.name: bus_factor.csv
distribution.description: Repository-level contributor concentration and bus-factor indicators.

distribution.name: citation_sweep.csv
distribution.description: Systematic OpenAlex citation sweep: one row per swept work, with its confidence tier (C1 confirmed / C2 probable / C3 print-dictionary envelope / C0 rejected), what it attests (digital resource vs print dictionary), the probe or citation-graph anchor that matched it, and whether it is an external or project-internal record.

distribution.name: commits.csv
distribution.description: Slim commit snapshot by repository, SHA, date, author, and subject.

distribution.name: contributor_identity.csv
distribution.description: Maintainer-reviewed contributor identity and ORCID readiness summary.

distribution.name: contributor_repo_heatmap.csv
distribution.description: Contributor x repository commit-count heatmap, top 15 contributors per repo.

distribution.name: contributor_specialisation.csv
distribution.description: Per-login specialisation metrics (normalized entropy, dominant-family commit share).

distribution.name: contributors.csv
distribution.description: Repository/login contribution counts from the GitHub snapshot.

distribution.name: data_index.csv
distribution.description: Catalog of public CSV/JSON data files with source scripts, generated dates, and caveats.

distribution.name: dict_record_counts.csv
distribution.description: <L> record count and distinct-<k1> headword count for every csl-orig v02 dictionary — the physical denominator and cap for population estimates.

distribution.name: etymology_marker_preliminary.csv
distribution.description: Preliminary per-dictionary etymology-style scan: Nirukta-marker share (WIL), Western comparative-form (cf.) counts (MW/MW72), and verbal-subentry counts (AP/AP90).

distribution.name: external_reach.csv
distribution.description: Scholar-framed external reach: GitHub stars/forks, 14-day clone/view traffic for core repos, downstream dependents (known consumers + code-search hits), and the citations found by the systematic OpenAlex sweep, in one tidy long table.

distribution.name: headword_key_collisions.csv
distribution.description: Per dictionary x linkage level: how often the record-linkage key merges two distinct records of that dictionary — the ambiguity cost of each level.

distribution.name: issue_lifecycle_backlog.csv
distribution.description: Backlog age pyramid: currently-open issues bucketed by age, with silent (zero-comment) counts.

distribution.name: issue_lifecycle_close.csv
distribution.description: Time-to-close percentiles (median/p25/p75/p90) per closing year, issues and PRs separately.

distribution.name: issue_lifecycle_repo.csv
distribution.description: Per-repository responsiveness: open/closed counts, close-latency percentiles, open-age median, silent-open count.

distribution.name: issue_lifecycle_survival.csv
distribution.description: Cohort survival: % of each opening-year cohort still open after 30/90/180/365/730/1460 days.

distribution.name: issue_typology_annual.csv
distribution.description: Annual issue counts by taxonomy/type label.

distribution.name: issues.csv
distribution.description: Slim issue and pull-request snapshot used by issue and taxonomy dashboards.

distribution.name: manifest.json
distribution.description: Snapshot manifest with data row counts and the current observatory snapshot date.

distribution.name: obs_q_annual.csv
distribution.description: Annual correction-sustainability aggregates by commits, correctors, and leading contributor share.

distribution.name: obs_q_latency.csv
distribution.description: Correction issue open/close latency inputs.

distribution.name: obs_q_per_dict.csv
distribution.description: Per-dictionary correction-sustainability aggregates.

distribution.name: people_summary.csv
distribution.description: Curated people summary used by contributor dashboards.

distribution.name: pulls.csv
distribution.description: Enriched pull-request snapshot: merged_at + merged boolean (merged vs closed-unmerged), head branch, agent body-marker boolean — the input to scripts/agent_lane.py.

distribution.name: pulls.meta.json
distribution.description: Fetch provenance for pulls.csv: GitHub REST endpoint, row count at fetch time and the fetcher's warnings.

distribution.name: pwg_citation_coverage.json
distribution.description: Summary of PWG <ls> citation link coverage: scan vs HTML targets over the translated article subset.

distribution.name: pwg_scan_index.csv
distribution.description: One row per PWG/PWK literary source in the 2025-2026 volunteer scan-indexing campaign: status, citation count, pages, volunteer, dates, scan directory.

distribution.name: pwg_scan_index_summary.json
distribution.description: Campaign aggregates behind the Scan-Index Campaign page: status distribution, per-volunteer throughput, monthly velocity, and the ranked unclaimed backlog.

distribution.name: repo_health.csv
distribution.description: Repository health flags for license, branch, activity, description, and cleanup risk.

distribution.name: repo_metadata.csv
distribution.description: Repository metadata-completeness snapshot for README, citation, templates, workflows, releases, Dependabot, and CodeQL.

distribution.name: repos.csv
distribution.description: Repository inventory with description, language, size, dates, branch, license, and archive state.

distribution.name: stats_census_register.csv
distribution.description: Org-wide statistics census register (H817/ROADMAP_STATISTICS_ORG_CENSUS): one row per Part-0 headline statistic across the 7 data layers (lexicon text, morphology, corpus, translation, roots, repo-meta, product), each with its computed value, done/partial/not_started status, owning repo, and source link.

distribution.name: taxonomy_adoption.csv
distribution.description: Annual taxonomy adoption metrics: typed, one-type, severity, milestone, and conformance rates.

distribution.name: timeseries_annual.csv
distribution.description: Annual repository activity aggregates for issues, pull requests, commits, and authors.

distribution.name: timeseries_monthly.csv
distribution.description: Monthly repository activity aggregates for issues, pull requests, commits, and authors.

distribution.name: velocity_timeline.csv
distribution.description: Organization-level yearly velocity and backlog summary.

distribution.name: wil_nirukta_tokens.csv
distribution.description: Top 16 Nirukta-style abbreviation tokens (aff., c., neg., fem., ...) found in WIL's .E. (etymology) blocks, with occurrence counts and glosses.

distribution.name: workflow_health.csv
distribution.description: Repository workflow/release reliability baseline covering workflows, scheduled jobs, artifact refresh, Dependabot, CodeQL, and releases.
